text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaaahhh~~!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I got a failing grade!!
Man, this is as pathetic as it gets!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
My, that's rare.
You usually manage to barely dodge them.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Dammit~! For the pride of a dorm leader,
I've managed to hold out somehow, but... I let my guard down!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The underclassmen have been getting so good lately,
I ended up getting totally caught up in one-on-ones...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Yup! All right, mind's made up!
Until the next test, I'm quitting one-on-ones!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh... Are you serious...?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll put all that time into studying instead!
A 'One-on-One Ban' is hereby in effect--!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Ama-neesan, fight me!
I've been in super top gear lately~!
I wanna test my strength!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Sorry, Biko!
I've put a ban on one-on-ones right now...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Eeeehh?! Big sis, a one-on-one ban?!
T-This is bad~~! Call an ambulance~~!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I don't need an ambulance, hey?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Hishi Ama-chan.
If you'd like, want to go work out at the gym together?
I'm definitely going to win our bench press showdown today, you know♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Guh... My bad, Laurel!
I've sealed away one-on-ones for now...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
............Huh? Eehh?
A-Are you all right?! Are you hurting anywhere—?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: No, no, no! Don't worry about me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Ama-san, I have a favor to ask.
Truth is...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
(A favor? ...—Wait, don't tell me!
Is she challenging me to a one-on-one?!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Gwaaaaaaahhh~~~!!
Ask me out again some other time~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
.........?
I just wanted to make a bento request, though...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Why is it that whenever times like this roll around,
everyone suddenly wants to challenge me to one-on-ones?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking around the academy, I spotted Hishi Amazon.
She looked completely worn out.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Who, me?
Ahaha, I'm fine, totally fiiiine...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Well, not really.
Holding back on one-on-ones so I could study for tests
has had me itching all over for a fight...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Maybe 'cause of that, my body feels heavy,
and I've lost my appetite... Haaah~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed holding back was putting her in terrible shape.
That just went to show how indispensable
one-on-one duels were to Hishi Amazon.
choice_data_list: Why not treat this test itself as a one-on-one duel?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
A one-on-one against the test... Ha!
I get it, that's it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
This is a serious deathmatch between winning with a high score
or losing with a red failing mark!
If that's the case, I've got no time to be slacking off!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight!!
Time to show 'em what Big Sis Hishi Ama's got when she's serious!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Re-energized, Hishi Amazon studied furiously,
and went on to score high marks on her test.
